note: Showrunner-authored. The dice pick WHEN a card fires and WHO spreads it — never write a new card at roll time. Cards must not touch locked facts or secrets marked hold.

cards.text: Someone saw a second coffee machine box in the loading dock. Unopened. Waiting.
Barry's putter has a name. Nobody will say it on the record.
The vending machine dispensed twice at 2am. Nobody was there.
Linda smiled on the rooftop last Thursday. Three witnesses. Zero corroboration.
There's a light on 16 that turns off exactly when you look at it.
Manny has a locked drawer. It rattles.
Evan's sixth badge opens a door nobody has found yet.
